signs.aries: You left home early or made your own, your household runs on momentum, and family disagreements are loud and quickly over.
signs.taurus: You want one home and to stay in it, fill it with comfortable and lasting things, and are unsettled by being moved.
signs.gemini: Home is where the conversation is; you may have had two of them, and your household is busy, verbal and rarely still.
signs.cancer: Home is the centre of your life rather than a base for it, and your family history has more hold on you than you generally admit.
signs.leo: Your home is somewhere you are proud to bring people, you are the warm centre of your family, and you host generously.
signs.virgo: You keep your home in order because disorder gets into your head, and you look after your family in practical rather than expressive ways.
signs.libra: You need your home to be beautiful and peaceful, and you will smooth over a family conflict rather than let it be aired.
signs.scorpio: Your family carries something unspoken, your home is private and defended, and your roots go deeper than you let on.
signs.sagittarius: You are from somewhere else, or made your home far from where you started, and your household is open-doored and unrestrained.
signs.capricorn: Responsibility arrived early at home, one parent set a demanding tone, and you built your own foundation deliberately and late.
signs.aquarius: Your domestic arrangements are unconventional by local standards, and your chosen family matters at least as much as the given one.
signs.pisces: Home is where you go to dissolve; the boundaries in your family are soft, and your sense of where you are from is dreamlike rather than fixed.
